observations: The page number «111» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it; at the right the number of the table, «Tab. 2a», in bold sans serif, underlined, the a raised. The two titles (L01, L02), in bold, their sigla in roman: the first that of M, the second that of N; the folios of the manuscripts, «M 82v, N 10v.», stand at the right of the second title, a little lower, the letters v raised; here as a margin note. The page has no signature; the table stands in the lower half of the page, below a wide blank space.

The table: a thick and a thin rule above the head, a double thin rule below it and a thin rule under «[Signa vel Notae]» over the seven numbered columns; vertical rules divide the ten columns; no rule closes the table at the foot. The head, L03-L05: «Numeri persa-rum» in three lines, «Nomina mensium» and «[Dies]» at mid height, and «[Signa vel Notae]» over the columns 1-7. Each printed row is one line here, the cells separated by our «|»; a head followed by empty cells spans their columns. The square brackets of «[Dies]» and «[Signa vel Notae]» are the editor's: the heads are missing in M and N (notes 3 and 4).

L06-L17. Checked: the Persian year has twelve months of 30 days and five added days after Ābān, the eighth month, 365 days in all. A month of 30 days moves the weekday on by 2 (30 = 4 × 7 + 2), Ābān with its 35 days by 0, and a year by 1 (365 = 52 × 7 + 1), so that the columns 1-7 are the seven years of the weekly cycle. The first value, 3, is Tuesday 16 June 632, the first day of Farvardīn of the year 1 of Yazdegird (1 for Sunday; p. 37, JP2 0069): all 84 values as printed, with the readings of notes a and b. The year Y of the era takes the column (Y − 1) mod 7 + 1.

N02: «Chordesme M —», the dash at the end of the line printed broken in two short pieces (9 and 13 px over 40 px); read as the long dash. N03: «Haharirááe», with two acute accents, «(sic)» the editor's. N04: «Bahamāme», with the macron.

N06-N08: Ms. M's marginal glosses on Arabic words of the tables: «elwacat», the «wasaṭ» of the mean motions (Suter, p. 41, JP2 0073), «elheza», «kamar», «arin» and «elkebice», the «kebice» of the leap years of Tab. 2; the editor's «(!)» marks the glosses «terra» and «annus». Italics: «om.», «sic», «Addid.», «in marg. :». The colons stand after the thin space of the edition (13 and 9 px).
